2609.26848.title: A Leakage-Aware Multimodal Evaluation Framework for Early Intraoperative Acute Kidney Injury Prediction
2609.26848.paper_summary: Postoperative acute kidney injury (AKI) after major non-cardiac surgery carries substantial morbidity, yet early intraoperative risk stratification remains difficult. In this retrospective cohort study, we propose SynerT, a waveform-only hybrid temporal backbone that combines a causal dilated TCN with a hierarchy of dilated recurrent layers to encode early intraoperative physiologic trajectories for AKI risk prediction. Building on SynerT, we further design two model variants that extend the backbone with structured clinical context: SynerT-MM, a late-fusion multimodal extension that integrates hemodynamic burden summaries and preoperative covariates, and SynerTStack, a leakage-safe stacked ensemble that combines cross-validated predictions from SynerT-MM with strong tabular baselines at the meta-learning stage. All models are evaluated under a strict leakage-aware framework on VitalDB, a high-fidelity perioperative database, with prediction restricted to information available within the first 60 intraoperative minutes. Among 2,413 waveform-usable cases (180 AKI-positive; 7.46% prevalence), SynerT fell well below strong structured-data baselines, demonstrating that waveform-only temporal modeling is insufficient under strict early constraints. SynerTMM recovered discrimination by incorporating hemodynamic burden summaries and preoperative covariates, and SynerT-Stack achieved the best overall performance across AUROC, AUPRC, and F1-max. Cross-fitted Platt recalibration substantially corrected calibration defects in both multimodal variants, and decision-curve analysis confirmed the recalibrated stacked model delivered the strongest net clinical benefit across low-to-intermediate thresholds.
2609.26848.paper_summary_zh: 術後急性腎損傷（AKI）在重大非心臟手術後帶來相當大的發病率，但早期的手術風險分層仍然困難。在這項回顧性隊列研究中，我們提出了SynerT，一種僅使用波形的混合時間骨幹，結合了因果膨脹的時間卷積網絡（TCN）與一系列膨脹的遞歸層，以編碼早期手術生理軌跡以預測AKI風險。在SynerT的基礎上，我們進一步設計了兩個模型變體，將結構化臨床背景擴展到骨幹中：SynerT-MM，一種晚融合的多模態擴展，整合了血流動力學負擔摘要和術前協變數，以及SynerT-Stack，一種防洩漏的堆疊集成，將SynerT-MM的交叉驗證預測與元學習階段的強表格基線結合。所有模型都在一個嚴格的防洩漏框架下在VitalDB上進行評估，這是一個高保真的圍手術數據庫，預測限制在手術前60分鐘內可用的信息。在2,413個可用波形的案例中（180個AKI陽性；7.46%的流行率），SynerT的表現遠低於強結構數據基線，顯示僅使用波形的時間建模在嚴格的早期限制下是不足夠的。SynerT-MM通過整合血流動力學負擔摘要和術前協變數恢復了區分能力，而SynerT-Stack在AUROC、AUPRC和F1-max的整體表現上達到了最佳。交叉擬合的Platt重新校準顯著修正了兩個多模態變體中的校準缺陷，決策曲線分析確認重新校準的堆疊模型在低至中等閾值下提供了最強的淨臨床效益。
